**Remote\-friendly \| Part\-time contract, 8\-12 hrs/week**

About Project HAPINES

Project HAPINES (History and Physicals in Nursing Education Systems) is an AI\-powered clinical simulation platform that teaches nurse practitioner students how to take a patient history, reason through differential diagnoses, and write competency\-mapped assessments and plans — aligned to the AACN/NONPF Essentials. Built at UT Austin in partnership with CHITA (Center for Health Innovations and Technology Advancements), HAPINES is an online nursing simulation platform.

This position is funded through a Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB) Nursing Innovation Grant Program award. Contract renewal beyond each 3\-month term is contingent on continued work.

The Role

We're looking for a coding expert to work directly with our small research team to optimize and extend the HAPINES platform — someone who's comfortable with both traditional software engineering and applied AI/LLM work, and who wants to build something real that's already in use with students.

What You'll Do

* Optimize performance, reliability, and cost\-efficiency of the existing AI patient\-simulation and grading engine
* Work with LLM APIs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI) to improve conversational realism, scoring consistency, and prompt reliability
* Improve and extend the faculty dashboard and competency\-mapping/analytics features
* Debug, refactor, and document existing code as the platform scales to more students and institutions
* Collaborate closely with the PI, CHITA's technical team, and other student developers on architecture and feature decisions
* Help evaluate hosting/infrastructure choices (AWS) for cost and performance

What We're Looking For

* Strong software engineering fundamentals — comfortable across backend, frontend, and databases
* Real experience working with LLM/AI APIs and prompt design, not just theoretical familiarity
* Ability to read and improve an existing codebase, not just build from scratch
* Self\-directed — this is a small team; you'll need to work well with limited day\-to\-day oversight
* Comfortable working within an academic/research environment and timeline

Nice to Have

* Experience with healthcare, EdTech, or simulation/training platforms
* Familiarity with FERPA or other student\-data privacy considerations
* Experience with LMS integrations (Canvas, LTI) or SSO
* Interest in health professions education or nursing/clinical workflows

Contract Details

* **Hours:** 8\-12 hours/week
* **Structure:** Initial 3\-month contract, with the option to renew in 3\-month increments for up to 24 months total, contingent on performance
* **Start date:** September 15, 2026
* **Compensation:** $100\-150/hour 8\-12 hours/week
* **Location:** Remote\-friendly; occasional availability for team check\-ins with UT Austin\-based collaborators via Zoom

title: Engineering Manager - Machine Design & Automation
description:
**Engineering Manager – Machine Design \& Automation**

**Lead the engineering. Build the machines. Collaborate on innovation.**

**About The Opportunity**

Our client designs and manufactures precision equipment used by cannabis processors for production and post\-processing. Their equipment includes cartridge filling and capping systems, flower infusion machines, vacuum ovens, and other specialized machinery.

This is a growing company with an entrepreneurial culture and a small, highly capable team. Founded five years ago, the company has grown sustainably and is continuing to expand its product line and engineering capabilities to meet customer needs.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager who wants to play a significant and meaningful role in that growth.

**The Opportunity**

This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role for someone who knows how to build machines—not simply manage engineers.

You will lead the company’s two\-person engineering team while continuing to contribute directly to machine design. Working closely with the CEO, you will take high\-level product ideas and turn them into organized, prioritized engineering projects that move from concept through design, testing, production, and launch.

This manufacturer currently develops proprietary new machines at a responsible rate and expects that pace to increase as the company grows. The Engineering Manager will help refine the engineering processes, team structure, and technical discipline needed to support that growth.

This is an opportunity to shape and build the engineering function at a growing company—not simply manage an established department. You’ll work directly with the CEO, have a voice in product direction, contribute to the design of new machines, and establish the engineering practices that will support the next stage of growth.

For the right person, the role can grow into a Director of Engineering position as the department expands.

**What You’ll Do to Lead Engineering**

* Provide day\-to\-day technical direction and prioritization for a two\-engineer team spanning mechanical engineering and electrical/controls/software.
* Review designs, solve technical problems, remove obstacles, and keep projects moving.
* Work directly with the CEO to translate product ideas into clearly defined engineering priorities and deliverables.
* Remain hands\-on with machine design and engineering rather than becoming a purely administrative manager.

**Design and Develop Automated Equipment**

* Personally contribute to the design and development of automated machinery.
* Bring strong mechanical design expertise, particularly in motion systems, linear motion, indexing and carousel mechanisms, pneumatics, and automated material handling.
* Evaluate whether components should be purchased off the shelf or designed in\-house.
* Apply practical knowledge of mechanical and electrical components, suppliers, and product families to make efficient design decisions.

**Drive Product Launches**

* Lead the engineering process from concept through production.
* Establish and maintain complete BOMs and engineering documentation.
* Coordinate testing and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT).
* Ensure smooth handoff from engineering to production and service.
* Establish and manage the Engineering Change Order (ECO) process after product release.
* Own the engineering portion of the CE certification process, working with an external certification consultant.

**Build the Engineering Team**

* Assess the strengths and development needs of the existing engineering team.
* Develop a thoughtful hiring plan as we expand our product\-development capabilities.
* Determine which engineering roles should be added, when they are needed, and why.
* Participate in hiring and help develop the engineering team as it grows.

**Build the Systems That Support Growth**

This company is intentionally building lightweight, practical engineering processes appropriate for a growing company. You’ll help establish the systems needed to improve execution without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

The engineering team uses ClickUp and an AI\-augmented engineering toolset for task management, documentation, analysis, and workflow development. You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you should be comfortable incorporating modern AI tools into your engineering work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 7\+ years of experience in machine design, equipment manufacturing, custom automation, or a related industrial equipment environment.
* **Candidates should be prepared to discuss a machine or piece of equipment they personally helped take from concept through production.**
* Experience as a technical lead, senior engineer, engineering manager, or similar technical leadership role.
* Strong hands\-on mechanical design experience with automated equipment.
* Demonstrated experience with motion systems, linear actuation, indexing/carousel mechanisms, pneumatics, and/or automated material handling.
* Experience personally taking industrial equipment from concept through design, launch, and production.
* Practical understanding of BOM release, engineering documentation, engineering change control, and production handoff.
* Working familiarity with CE marking or comparable equipment certification processes.
* Strong knowledge of commercially available mechanical and electrical components and when to use standard components versus custom designs.
* Comfortable serving as the senior technical presence with both engineers and production personnel.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize work, make decisions, and keep engineering projects moving.
* Willingness to work in a hands\-on, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can move quickly.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering is welcome but **not required**. Demonstrated machine\-building expertise and results matter most.

**Experience in any of the following is a plus**:

* Cannabis, food, pharmaceutical, packaging, or other processing equipment
* PLCs, CODESYS, EtherNet/IP, or industrial controls
* ERP systems and engineering BOM management; Odoo experience is a plus
* Building or introducing engineering processes within a small or growing company
* Hiring and developing engineering teams
* Using AI or LLM tools for engineering documentation, analysis, specifications, or workflow automation

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to build the engineering function at a growing company—not simply manage an established department.

You’ll work directly with the CEO, have a voice in product direction, contribute to the design of new machines, and establish the engineering practices that will support DDS’s next stage of growth.

If you are a strong machine builder who is ready to take greater ownership—and excited by the opportunity to shape how a growing company engineers and launches its products—we’d like to hear from you.

We offer a full benefit package. The starting salary range is in the 140K\-165K range commensurate with experience. This is primarily an on\-site position but there is some flexibility for some work from home days.

Thank you for your interest in our new role. We are excited to welcome our new Engineering Manager to the team!

Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Experience:

* designing automated machinery or custom equipment: 7 years (Preferred)
* designing motion systems: 5 years (Preferred)
* taking machines from concept to production: 5 years (Preferred)
* leading engineering teams: 3 years (Preferred)
* with BOMs and ECOs: 3 years (Preferred)

Description:
**QA Manager \| Fort Worth, TX**  

**Onsite \| Full\-Time \| Electronics Manufacturing**  

  

Elizabeth Banzhaf, LPN  

Co\-Founder \& COO \| Heartline Staffing  

Call or Text: **272\-230\-3157**

**Prefer a quick conversation?** **Call or text Elizabeth directly.**  

  

Heartline Staffing, in partnership with Purple Cow Recruiting, is seeking an experienced **QA Manager** for a high\-volume electronics manufacturing operation in Fort Worth, Texas.  

  

This is a senior quality leadership opportunity for a professional with extensive experience in electronics manufacturing, Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), contract manufacturing, or a closely related environment. The QA Manager will lead site Quality Assurance functions, maintain the Quality Management System, oversee quality teams, manage customer and supplier quality initiatives, and drive measurable continuous improvement across manufacturing operations.  

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**  

  

The QA Manager will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems that ensure compliance with customer requirements, industry standards, and operational objectives. This individual will partner closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Program Management, Supply Chain, suppliers, and customers to improve product quality, reliability, and manufacturing performance.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

* Lead and maintain the site's Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, TL9000, customer requirements, and applicable standards
* Establish and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, and process controls
* Ensure ongoing compliance with internal, customer, and external certification requirements
* Oversee Incoming Quality Control (IQC), In\-Process Quality Control (IPQC), Outgoing Quality Control (OQC), and Quality Engineering functions
* Develop, monitor, and improve quality metrics including First Pass Yield (FPY), Defects Per Million (DPPM), customer returns, Cost of Quality (COQ), and corrective\-action closure rates
* Serve as the primary escalation point for customer quality concerns
* Manage customer audits, assessments, quality reviews, complaints, and corrective actions
* Lead structured root\-cause analysis using 8D, Fishbone Analysis, 5 Why, PFMEA, DFMEA, and Statistical Process Control (SPC)
* Drive CAPA programs and Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma quality initiatives
* Partner with Supply Chain and Supplier Quality teams to improve supplier performance
* Participate in supplier audits, qualification activities, corrective actions, and performance reviews
* Manage and develop Quality Engineers, Quality Supervisors, Technicians, and Inspectors
* Establish performance goals and provide coaching, mentorship, technical guidance, and performance evaluations
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) from design transfer through mass production
* Participate in process validation, qualification, and manufacturing\-readiness reviews
* Ensure appropriate quality controls are established during product launches
* Partner cross\-functionally to identify manufacturing risks, reduce defects, and improve operational efficiency

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  

  

This is a fully onsite position in a fast\-paced electronics manufacturing environment. The QA Manager will interact regularly with production personnel, engineers, managers, customers, and suppliers. Flexibility may occasionally be required to support production schedules, audits, customer visits, and critical business needs. Occasional domestic and international travel may also be required.  

  

**BENEFITS**  

  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company\-paid basic life insurance
* Voluntary life insurance options
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match, currently 5% after six months subject to eligibility and plan terms
* Paid time off
* Company\-paid holidays
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP), where available
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Career advancement opportunities
* Annual performance incentive program of up to 7%, subject to eligibility and plan guidelines

Requirements:
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality Management, or Related Field **REQUIRED**
* Minimum 7 Years of Progressive Quality Experience in Electronics Manufacturing, EMS, Contract Manufacturing, or Related Industry **REQUIRED**
* Minimum 3 Years of Management or Supervisory Experience **REQUIRED**
* Quality Management System (QMS) Leadership Experience **REQUIRED**
* Strong Knowledge of Quality Methodologies, Statistical Analysis, and Process Improvement Tools **REQUIRED**
* Experience with 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, PFMEA/DFMEA, SPC, and CAPA **REQUIRED**
* Experience Managing Customer Audits and Quality Performance Metrics **REQUIRED**
* Experience Leading Cross\-Functional Quality Initiatives **REQUIRED**
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Minitab, ERP Systems, and Quality Reporting Tools **REQUIRED**
* Ability to Work Fully Onsite in Fort Worth, TX 76177 **REQUIRED**
* Strong Leadership and Employee Development Capabilities **REQUIRED**
* Strong Analytical, Root\-Cause Analysis, and Problem\-Solving Skills **REQUIRED**
* Knowledge of Manufacturing Quality Systems and Process Controls **REQUIRED**
* Ability to Interpret Technical Drawings, Specifications, and Manufacturing Documentation **REQUIRED**
* Strong Written and Verbal Communication Skills **REQUIRED**
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) Preferred
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt Preferred
* Experience Supporting Fortune 500 Technology Customers Preferred
* Telecommunications, Networking, AI Server, Data Center, Cloud Computing, or Electronics Manufacturing Experience Preferred
* Familiarity with IPC Standards, ESD Controls, and Electronics Assembly Quality Requirements Preferred

  

Not ready to apply? If your background includes senior\-level quality leadership within electronics manufacturing, EMS, or contract manufacturing and you'd prefer to discuss the opportunity first, call or text Elizabeth directly at **272\-230\-3157**.

description:

**General Summary:**

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next\-generation experiences and drive communication and data processing transformation, helping create a smarter, more connected future for all.


Qualcomm is seeking talented Physical Design Engineers to join our growing SoC and ASIC Design organization.


Successful candidates will have the opportunity to contribute across a variety of projects spanning high\-performance computing, AI, mobile, automotive, data center, and next\-generation semiconductor technologies. Engineers in this role may work on different aspects of Physical Design ASIC and SoC development, including floorplan, Clock Tree Synthesis, low power implementation, timing analysis, design methodology, automation and enabling new technology nodes.


This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast\-paced engineering team developing leading\-edge products on advanced process technologies while collaborating with world\-class design, verification, implementation, and physical design teams.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 2\+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 1\+ year of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Science, Engineering, or related field.
**Role Overview**

Qualcomm Technologies' Digital ASIC team is seeking talented Physical Design Engineers to join our SoC and Core Design organization. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing complex digital designs using industry\-leading methodologies and EDA tools, contributing to the delivery of high\-performance and power\-efficient products.


You will participate in the complete physical design flow for sophisticated SoCs and IPs, including GPU, Camera, Multimedia, DDR, Modem, Audio, and other cutting\-edge semiconductor solutions. This position provides the opportunity to work on advanced implementation techniques, low\-power methodologies, and optimization strategies that improve performance, power efficiency, and silicon area.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute and drive all stages of the physical design flow from synthesized netlist to tape\-out.
* Develop and implement physical design solutions for complex, high\-speed, and low\-power ASICs and SoCs.
* Perform floorplanning, partitioning, power planning, and IR\-drop analysis.
* Execute placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, timing optimization, and timing closure across Multi\-Mode Multi\-Corner (MMMC) scenarios.
* Analyze and resolve timing violations, signal integrity issues, crosstalk effects, and physical design rule violations.
* Perform RC extraction, physical verification, and formal verification activities.
* Implement engineering change orders (ECOs) and support design convergence through sign\-off.
* Collaborate with architecture, RTL, DFT, verification, and methodology teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Contribute to the development of innovative low\-power implementation methodologies and customized place\-and\-route solutions.
Develop automation and productivity tools using scripting languages and software development techniques.  
* 

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
2\+ years of industry experience or relevant academic/project experience in Physical Design.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
* ASIC/SoC Physical Design implementation.
* Place and Route using Cadence Innovus and/or Synopsys Fusion Compiler.
* Static Timing Analysis and timing closure using Synopsys PrimeTime SI.
* Physical verification and design sign\-off methodologies.
* Formal verification techniques and tools.
* Power domain implementation and low\-power design methodologies.
* Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), routing, and timing optimization.
* Signal integrity, noise analysis, and MMMC sign\-off flows.
* DFT\-aware physical implementation and constraint management.
* Programming and automation using Python, Perl, TCL, Shell scripting, C/C\+\+, and Linux/Unix environments.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Fleet Telemetry & Control/Rust
description:
**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Remote/Hybrid Available)


**What is Verse?**



The race to AI has become the race to power. Every breakthrough in artificial intelligence depends on one thing: access to electricity. But across the country, aging grid infrastructure and years\-long interconnection queues are slowing the deployment of the data centers that will power the next generation of innovation. Solving this challenge isn't just about energy—it's about unlocking the future of AI.



At Verse, we're building the energy intelligence platform for the AI economy. Our software helps the world's largest energy consumers achieve faster, cheaper, and cleaner power by combining real\-time control of energy assets with complete visibility into their energy portfolio. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, GV, Coatue, and NVIDIA, and built by pioneers in grid\-scale batteries, energy markets, and enterprise software, we're redefining how the world's most ambitious organizations access and manage energy.


**The Role**



As a Software Engineer focused on Fleet Telemetry \& Control at Verse, you will be working closely with our energy solutions partners to design, implement, and test distributed energy resource controls and telemetry software on customer hardware at sites around the world. You will be part of a dynamic, high\-performance team building applications directly on bare\-metal or on hardware\-level virtualization platforms. As an advanced technical leader in network programming and state management development, engineering teams will look to you for best standards and practices for interfacing with on\-premises grid assets using solutions you will build and maintain.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Foster a culture and mindset of well\-designed systems, test\-driven software, and transparent communication with a high caliber of mutual respect and consideration for stakeholders
* Mentor and support career and junior level engineers in their fleet telemetry and control software career development
* Collaborate closely with energy solutions providers on their proprietary hardware and on\-premises software stacks
* Design, implement, and test software for supervisory distributed energy resource control and telemetry applications with heterogeneous OEM hardware, sensor/actuator networks, and remote terminal units
* Develop high\-performance, production\-grade applications optimized for resource\- and bandwidth\-constrained environments
* Provide specifications for over\-the\-air (OTA) update of on\-prem software and remote access solutions for customers
* Implement and enforce best security practices for critical infrastructure and cyber\-physical systems

* Technical leadership and commitment to delivering high quality software on time or ahead of schedule, and adhering to best software development practices
* Strong programming skills with systems languages such as C/C\+\+, Rust or Go

* Advanced Rust programming knowledge

* Experience with one or more battery energy storage technologies from Tesla, Sungrow, LG/NEC, or Fluence

We understand that each of these forces must be applied with diligence: When we act, we act carefully and responsibly. Speed, hard work, and perseverance must be accompanied by thoughtfulness and reflection.
* **We are pursuing a labor of love.** We are passionate about renewable energy technology, and we like to dream big. We are disrupting the largest and most expensive machine humanity has ever built – the electricity system. We believe the greatest impact we can have on the climate crisis is through building elegant solutions and exceptional products that delight our customers.


**Base Pay Range**



$160,000 \- $194,000

A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to level, skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.*

title: AI SoC Architect Networking
description:
About Majestic Labs
  
  

We’re a fast\-moving, US\-Israeli AI startup building next\-generation infrastructure for the world’s most demanding AI workloads. Our mission is to accelerate the future of intelligence and make it ubiquitously accessible by delivering full stack custom AI servers optimized for large\-scale inference and training.
  
  

Backed by top\-tier investors and led by industry veterans, we’re scaling rapidly. We seek forward\-thinking engineers and operators who thrive in a collaborative environment and excel at solving complex challenges from first principles. If you want to build infrastructure that fundamentally changes what the world can accomplish with AI, come join us!
  
  

About the position
  
  

﻿This is a highly technical and cross\-functional role requiring deep expertise in SoC networking, high\-speed interconnects, and protocol acceleration for AI. As a SOC System Network Architect for AI, you will lead the definition and architectural design of network engines and interconnect fabrics powering our custom AI servers. You will collaborate closely with silicon architecture, hardware design, firmware, and software teams to shape scale\-up and scale\-out networking topologies optimized for distributed AI workloads.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect end\-to\-end SoC networking engines, SmartNIC/NIC architectures, and switch interface IPs for AI accelerators

title: Expert Claude Code Creator for Fast-Growth Tech, Build, Automate, and Lead the AI Wave
description:
AI is exploding. Our products are everywhere. We’re rewriting the rules on how local businesses sell, advertise, and win using EZ\-AD TV, Dentaloo, and EZ\-Commerce. From barbershops to Walmart, we’re the engine behind screens, software, and marketing that just works. If you live for building with bleeding\-edge AI and can prompt circles around the competition, keep reading. Only A\-players. Only builders. Only now.
We have momentum you can feel. 30,000\+ units sold. Seven countries. Big brands, retail chains, and tens of thousands of small business owners using our platforms every day. You’re not joining a sleepy company, you’re joining a rocketship. The only thing growing faster than our user base is the demand for automations, integrations, and rapid\-fire innovation. This is your chance to be the AI expert other devs turn to.
Claude code is our next unlock. You’ll architect, prompt, and build workflows that make our tech smarter, faster, and easier for the end user. Think: Zapier meets ChatGPT, but for the real world of screens, sales, and retail. If you can show us what’s possible, the upside is massive. Get in early, build things that last, and shape the future of local business automation.
**WHY THIS JOB IS DIFFERENT**
-----------------------------


* No pointless meetings, no slow committees. We move fast and ship faster.
* You’ll work on real products, not demos or vaporware. What you build will be used by thousands within weeks.
* Your prompts, code, and workflow designs will power everything from digital signage to e\-commerce automation. If you have ideas, we want them implemented.
* This is not a code\-only cave job. You’ll talk to users, test with real data, and see the impact of your work instantly.
* We’re only hiring one or two experts at this level. Join at the ground floor and define how we do AI, forever.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO**
---------------------------


* Design, test, and deploy advanced Claude code prompts and workflows that automate and enhance our products (EZ\-AD TV, Dentaloo, EZ\-Commerce).
* Prototype, iterate, and refine AI\-driven solutions for both internal teams and external customers.
* Work closely with product, sales, and support to translate real\-world user needs into robust automations and tools.
* Document, teach, and evangelize best practices for prompt engineering and workflow design, make others better.
* Jump into live troubleshooting and rapid iteration as needed. You’re available, agile, and flexible when the work calls for it.
* Act as our internal go\-to expert for all things Claude code and code X. If it can be automated, you’ll find a way.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------


* Expert\-level skill with Claude code and related AI prompt engineering (show us a portfolio: personal, professional, or both).
* Proven ability to design, test, and optimize AI\-driven workflows, not just toy examples but real, working solutions.
* Natural communicator. You can explain complex logic to non\-technical teammates and inspire users with what’s possible.
* Flexible, responsive, and hungry. You like solving new problems every day. You don’t wait for instructions, you create your own roadmap.
* Deep understanding of user workflows and the “why” behind every automation. You think like a user, not just a coder.
* Passion for the future of AI and excitement about changing how businesses work at scale.
* Availability throughout the day to jump on calls, test, and collaborate. We move fast and expect the same.

**WHAT YOU GET**
----------------


* Early, high\-impact seat on a team that’s changing entire industries. What you build will be used by thousands, fast.
* Strong base compensation plus performance upside. Let’s talk specifics based on your level and impact.
* Remote flexibility. As long as you’re available and communicative, we don’t care where you sit.
* Direct access to founders, leadership, and decision\-makers. Your work shapes our roadmap.
* Resources to test, break, and build with the best AI tools available.
* A team of A\-players who will push you to do your best work, and have fun while doing it.


This is not a corporate job. This is a movement. If you’re the best Claude code engineer in every room you walk into, show us your portfolio and let’s build the future together.
